http_method
       Returns the type of HTTP request method.

SYNOPSIS
       http_method

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the action of the HTTP request. Common values are GET and POST. This command is a BIG-IP version 4.X variable,
       provided for backward-compatibility. You can use the equivalent 9.Xcommand HTTP::method instead.

       Syntax

       http_method

	    * Specifies the action of the HTTP request. Common values are GET and
	      POST.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
       HTTP::method

CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
